meta.description: Family Italian bakery in Dorval since 2002. Wood-oven pizza, panini, pastry, and gelato on the Lakeshore.

home.title: Not just bread.
home.lead: Wood-oven pizza, Italian pastry, and gelato on the Lakeshore. A family bakery. Come early for lunch.
home.cateringLead: Office lunches, family parties, trays of pasta and wood-oven pizza. Call or write — they set it up from the Dorval shop.

catering.title: Catering
catering.lead: They bake for more than the counter. Pizza, pasta, panini, pastry, and gelato for the table — offices, birthdays, and Lakeshore gatherings.
catering.body: The shop has posted catering from Dorval. There is no public catering card with prices, so they quote by the date and the headcount. Give them a day or two when you can.
catering.pizzaNote: Napoletana and Roman, made in the shop. Order ahead.
catering.pastaNote: Tortellini, manicotti, cannelloni, ravioli — the same plates as the counter.
catering.paniniNote: Italian sandwiches and small salads for a lunch spread.
catering.bakeryNote: Cannoli, zeppole, cookies, cakes, and gelato by the half-litre.
catering.note: Lead time and prices depend on the day. Call 514.631.2000 or email info@nonsolopane.ca. Do not treat this as a fixed package list.

about.title: About
about.lead: Non solo pane — not just bread. A family bakery on Chemin du Bord-du-Lac since 2002.
about.body: They bake. They fire pizza in a wood oven. They fill cannoli and zeppole. There is gelato, espresso, a small Italian grocery, and a terrace when the lake is warm. Counter service. A line at noon. Regulars come back for the crust and the cookies.
about.note: Hours vary by source. Call 514.631.2000 before you cross town.

menu.title: Menu
menu.lead: Prices from their Uber Eats card. Pizza is in the shop — wood oven. Delivery hours there are shorter than the bakery.
